description: Java class defining a REST API resource for internal savings account information, including a method to fetch savings account IDs by status, with logging and Spring annotations.

classes.name: InternalSavingsAccountInformationApiResource
classes.description: A REST API resource class for internal savings account operations, including fetching account IDs by status with logging and Spring annotations.

methods.name: afterPropertiesSet
methods.description: Initialization method that logs a warning indicating internal savings account services are enabled and should not be used in production.

methods.name: getSavingsAccountsByStatus
methods.description: Handles GET requests to fetch savings account IDs filtered by status ID, logs the request, and returns the list of IDs.
